label: PF Backlog 588
title: dogfood: drive pipeline to completion + correct post-run validation + fail-closed verdict
body:
## Problem / why
dogfood.run enqueues then validates the baseline worktree immediately (core/dogfood.py:79-89; verdict :114-128);
PASS requires pipeline.status=='enqueued' which never becomes 'done'.

## Goal / value
Wait for the run to finish (bounded), validate the GENERATED product dir, and map terminal states fail-closed.

## In scope
- Enqueue (canonical) -> ensure runner -> bounded wait on run_status/job state -> validate product dir.
- Verdict: pipeline failed->FAIL; timeout/could-not-start->BLOCKED; dry->PARTIAL_SUCCESS; done+PASS->PASS;
  done+FAIL->FAIL; done+unknown->PARTIAL_SUCCESS.

## Out of scope
- A second engine/store; blocking HTTP without a wait/flag decision.

## Acceptance criteria
- dogfood on a small idea runs all stages then returns PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED correctly; dry never PASS.

## Verification / test plan
- dogfood_check updated; e2e run observed; no regression of existing dogfood tests.

## Dependencies & links
- Eventing SSOT epic (BI-PF-1265) progress signals; BI-PF-1266 decisions.
